text:
drew_sales: Quick sync request — Rubicon POC has tightened identity requirements. Need to confirm SSO + SCIM + RBAC fit before we hand off the trial.

sana_se: I can jump in. What's the tightest ask?

drew_sales: They want IdP + SP-initiated SAML, SCIM v2 delta patches, delegated admin for tenant ops, and domain-ownership enforced for provisioning. CISO wants answers by Friday.

omar_security: Heads up: they require customer-managed keys (BYOK) and HSM/FIPS mention in questionnaire. Also ask for immutable audit trails and >=180d retention options.

lee_pm: From product: Dedicated trial ok. Note: our default audit retention is 90 days; we can offer 180/365 as an enterprise opt-in.

nora_eng: SCIM details: we support /Provisioned/Users and Groups, incremental (delta) sync via /ChangeLogs. Rate limits: 1200 ops/min for enterprise POC; bulk imports should be chunked. If they plan >50k users we need to run a bulk import job (offline).

sana_se: They have a transient NameID; they want email as NameID for assertions. We can map SAML attributes in the SSO config but need to validate the incoming NameID format. Also they want group claims mapped to roles (e.g., group "engineering-admins" -> role admin). Currently mapping logic is via our admin API only.

nora_eng: Workaround for RBAC mapping during POC: run a lightweight sync lambda that listens to SCIM change events and calls our admin mapping endpoint. Example snippet below.

sana_se: ```
# pseudo code for mapping group -> role during POC
import requests
resp = requests.post("https://api.redwood.ai/admin/role-mappings", json={
  "group":"engineering-admins",
  "role":"tenant_admin"
}, headers={"Authorization":"Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"})
print(resp.status_code)
```

alexa_billing: Pricing: we can provide credits covering up to 250k tokens/day. Anything above requires a short-term paid overage or a small commit. I can produce a one-page SOW and trial terms.

drew_sales: Good. I'll set expectations. Also Rubicon wants domain verification to lock tenant creation — they prefer uploading a verification file rather than DNS. Do we support file upload flow?

nora_eng: We support DNS TXT by default. File upload can be accommodated for the POC via our support portal (we'll manually verify and flip the tenant flag). Note: cert issuance is automated after domain verification.

omar_security: For the questionnaire: confirm KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault) and rotation every 90 days is supported via CMK rotation policies. Also note we store only encrypted secrets and keys are not exportable.

verify_bot: domain_check: rubicon.co verified via manual_upload (ticket #5482). ssl_cert_issued: true.

sana_se: Action list: 1) I will draft the SSO mapping instructions with screenshots. 2) Nora will document SCIM rate limits and bulk import steps. 3) Alexa will send trial SOW/credits. 4) Omar to fill security Q answers.

lee_pm: I'll consolidate actions into the deal tracker and set a tech preflight for tomorrow 10:30am PT.

drew_sales: Thanks — I'll post the preflight invite to Rubicon and include the runbook draft once Sana shares.
